guide.orespawn.welcome.title: Welcome to OreSpawn
guide.orespawn.welcome.1: OreSpawn is a world-building engine used by other mods. Installed alone, it leaves terrain and vanilla ores unchanged.
guide.orespawn.welcome.2: Provider mods can supply rocks, ores, fluid deposits, and ready-made settings. Ore-only mods do not have to add rock layers.
guide.orespawn.welcome.3: Recommended Defaults restores the choices supplied by your installed mods and mod pack. It is the safest place to start.
guide.orespawn.world.title: Choose Your Geology
guide.orespawn.world.1: Your choices are copied into this world when it is created. A template loads a complete setup supplied by a mod or mod pack.
guide.orespawn.world.2: Rock layers are optional. Sky makes biome-influenced geological regions called geomes. Cyano (Legacy) uses the classic older layer engine.
guide.orespawn.world.3: Formation Reach controls width. Layer Thickness controls depth. Waviness bends layers, Edge Detail roughens their borders, and Continuity keeps formations together.
guide.orespawn.rocks.title: Rocks and Geomes
guide.orespawn.rocks.1: Sedimentary, metamorphic, and igneous rocks form in different places and at different depths. Geomes decide which families suit each region.
guide.orespawn.rocks.2: Open Rocks & Ores to edit a block. Removing a rock only stops it appearing in new terrain; the block and its recipes stay available for old worlds.
guide.orespawn.rocks.3: Configure Rock Strata starts with stone, deepslate, granite, diorite, andesite, and tuff. Add Block can deliberately include mod rocks or special vanilla blocks.
guide.orespawn.ores.title: Ores and Fluids
guide.orespawn.ores.1: Ore-only mods can use OreSpawn in ordinary vanilla stone. Ore Richness halves or doubles deposits while preserving their depth and shape.
guide.orespawn.ores.2: Each ore can have settings for several dimensions. Patterns shape deposits, while Hosts choose which rocks or block tags the ore may replace.
guide.orespawn.ores.3: Manage Vanilla Ores controls configured vanilla ores. With rock strata active, open Fluid Deposits, press Add, and choose water, lava, or an installed mod fluid.
guide.orespawn.mods.title: Using Other Mods
guide.orespawn.mods.1: Blocks and biomes from installed mods appear in the pickers. OreSpawn does not need a hard dependency just to use their registry names.
guide.orespawn.mods.2: Provider mods and mod packs can supply ready-made rocks, ores, biome influences, dimensions, and templates. OreSpawn validates them before generation.
guide.orespawn.mods.3: Full registry IDs, such as minecraft:calcite, identify blocks safely. Missing blocks or invalid settings are rejected before a world is generated.
guide.orespawn.server.title: Worlds and Servers
guide.orespawn.server.1: Your choices are saved in serverconfig/orespawn-worldgen.json inside the world. Keep that file when moving the world to a dedicated server.
guide.orespawn.server.2: Changes affect newly generated chunks only. Land you have already explored is never rewritten.
guide.orespawn.server.3: A server needs the same mods used by the profile. For a new server world, a pack author may instead prepare config/orespawn-worldgen.json.
tooltip.orespawn.geology_mode: Sky uses biome-influenced geomes. Cyano (Legacy) uses the original Cyano rock-layer engine.
tooltip.orespawn.manage_vanilla_ores: Replace vanilla ore features with OreSpawn's configured vein, cluster, and cloud deposits.
tooltip.orespawn.ore_richness: Scales attempts per chunk from this ore's installed-pack default. Each step halves or doubles abundance, up to the 64-attempt safety limit; depth and deposit shape stay unchanged.
tooltip.orespawn.available_dimension: Lists dimensions from the current world settings and installed mod data. The registry ID below remains editable for server-only dimensions.
tooltip.orespawn.horizontal_size: Controls how far individual rock formations persist horizontally.
tooltip.orespawn.vertical_thickness: Controls the typical vertical thickness of rock layers.
tooltip.orespawn.waviness: Controls the broad vertical slope and curvature of rock layers.
tooltip.orespawn.edge_irregularity: Adds independent small-scale detail along layer boundaries.
tooltip.orespawn.formation_continuity: Controls how often formations retain their identity across regional and geome boundaries.
